assessment: Giant dsDNA viruses, with genomes in excess of 1Mb encoding more than one thousand genes, were only recently discovered and their study offers new opportunities to probe life's mechanisms. Little is known how these "organisms" protect and organize their genomes. This fascinating study reveals a helical protein assembly comprised of oxidoreductase-family proteins, which assemble into multi-start helical fibers, with genomic DNA lining the lumen of the fiber.
